experiment_name: Acer AMD Radeon native Windows OpenCL GEMM baseline

protocol.independence: fresh child process and OpenCL context per run
protocol.end_to_end_scope: host before enqueue A/B writes through completion of C read
protocol.transfer_scope: H2D=sum of A/B write events; D2H=C read event

environment.execution: native Windows; AMD OpenCL; no ROCm or CUDA

runs.reference: CPU math.fsum of FP32 inputs, rounded to FP32 output

device.global_memory_note: Includes shared memory; not dedicated VRAM
